title: Bursa Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BTSO) says cyberattack gave unauthorized access to some personal data
date_note: The pages give only the day the chairman briefed the assembly; the attack date is not stated.
org: Bursa Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BTSO)
geo_basis: BTSO's home city, as named in the source
summary: BTSO Chairman Özer Matlı told the chamber's November general assembly that hackers attacked its information systems, and initial findings show some personal data was accessed without authorization. According to the reports, the chamber notified the relevant official bodies and hired a cybersecurity firm. Matlı said initial findings point to a flaw in custom software built under the previous management; the affected data is still being determined.
plain: BTSO's chairman says hackers attacked the chamber's systems and some personal data was accessed without authorization. Which data was affected is still being determined.
exec: A Turkish chamber of commerce reports a cyberattack with unauthorized access to some personal data; the scope is not yet known.

validation.note: Two independent Bursa publishers (Bursa'da Bugün, Bursa Hakimiyet) each report the chairman's statement; BTSO's own page was not read.
